q: The relationship between entropy and computation in thermodynamics is quantified by the fact that a reversible computer can perform computations with:
opts: Zero energy dissipation in principle (Fredkin gate, Toffoli gate enable reversible computation)
Energy proportional to entropy of output
exp: Reversible computing (Landauer-Bennett): logically reversible gates (Toffoli, Fredkin) can perform computations in principle without dissipating energy—information is never erased. Only logically irreversible operations (like erasure/fan-out) require energy dissipation (kT ln 2 per bit).
